task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Move BOX_TOP to TEMP_TABLE to access BOX_MIDDLE. Pick BOX_MIDDLE and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. Then retrieve BOX_TOP from TEMP_TABLE and place it back on BOX_BOTTOM to maintain the stack with only the middle removed.
assumptions: The robot starts at (0,0) and can navigate to the specified coordinates.
BOX_TOP is currently on top of BOX_MIDDLE and must be moved first to access BOX_MIDDLE.
TEMP_TABLE and INSPECTION_TABLE are valid locations for placing objects.
Restoring BOX_TOP onto BOX_BOTTOM is required to satisfy the condition that the stack looks like only the middle box was removed.
